pages.text: Salt, sulfur, and quicksilver are substances that are naturally attuned to their home dimensions: the Overworld, Nether, and End respectively. Their primary use is for $(l:otherverse:binding/fleshbinding)fleshbinding$().
Salt can be found on the ocean floor in the Overworld.
Sulfur can be found as an ore in the Nether.
Quicksilver is only found in trace amounts in the End, but fortunately, Endermen naturally concentrate it in their pearls.

The three Primes can be combined into cinnabar, which can be used to craft Spawn Altars and Spirit Tablets. Cinnabar blocks can be used to $(l:otherverse:binding/fleshbinding#cinnabar)easily transport bound mobs$().
